name: InfiniSweeper
author: ammealey@googlemail.com
description: Infinite co-op minesweeper. Serves the game and its PHP multiplayer backend on the server's primary allocation port. Multiplayer room saves are kept in data/rooms.
startup: if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = "1" ] && [ -d .git ]; then git fetch -q --depth 1 origin {{GIT_BRANCH}} && git reset --hard FETCH_HEAD; fi; runtime/php -c pterodactyl/php.ini -q -S 0.0.0.0:{{SERVER_PORT}} -t . pterodactyl/router.php

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# InfiniSweeper install script. Runs as root in the installer container, with the server's files at /mnt/server.
# Reinstalling updates the game and PHP. Room saves in data/rooms are gitignored, so they're kept.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

echo "== Fetching ${GIT_REPO} (${GIT_BRANCH})"
git config --global --add safe.directory /mnt/server   # the folder belongs to the server's user, not root
[ -d .git ] || git init -q
git remote add origin "${GIT_REPO}" 2>/dev/null || git remote set-url origin "${GIT_REPO}"
git fetch -q --depth 1 origin "${GIT_BRANCH}"
git reset --hard FETCH_HEAD

# The official PHP images don't run an egg's startup command, so the server runs on a plain yolk image with a static
# PHP build from static-php.dev, kept in runtime/.
ARCH=$(uname -m)   # x86_64 or aarch64, as static-php.dev names them
LISTING=https://dl.static-php.dev/static-php-cli/common/
FILE=$(curl -fsSL "$LISTING" | grep -oE "php-${PHP_VERSION}\.[0-9]+-cli-linux-${ARCH}\.tar\.gz" | sort -uV | tail -n 1) || true
if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then
    echo "No static PHP ${PHP_VERSION} build for ${ARCH} at ${LISTING}" >&2
    exit 1
fi
echo "== Installing ${FILE}"
rm -rf runtime
mkdir runtime
curl -fsSL "${LISTING}${FILE}" | tar xz -C runtime php
chmod 755 runtime/php
runtime/php -v

echo "== Done. Start the server, then open http://<server address>:<port>"

variables.name: Git Repository
variables.description: Where the game is downloaded from. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch to install and update from.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: 1 pulls the latest code from the branch every time the server starts. 0 keeps what's installed. Files you edit in the server folder are overwritten either way on update; room saves are kept.

variables.name: PHP Workers
variables.description: How many requests PHP handles at once. Each multiplayer player polls up to 10 times a second; 4 is plenty for a few busy rooms.

variables.name: PHP Version
variables.description: Static PHP build downloaded from static-php.dev at install; the newest patch release of this version is used. Reinstall the server after changing it.
